course_summary:
ISEN 663 | Engineering Management Control Systems | Fall 2026
Instructor: Michael Do | mddo@tamu.edu
Meets: T 5:30PM-8:00PM | ZACH 445
Grading: Class Discussions [25%], Assignments [25%], Semester Project [25%], Final Exam [25%]
Topics: IDEF Modeling Tools, Value Stream Mapping, MCS Frameworks, Objects of Control, Financial Responsibility Centers, Pre-Action Control, Socio-Technical Systems, Highly Reliable Organizations, AI and NextGEN ORG Design, systems engineering (SE) principles, SE practices, SE methods, management control system principles, management control system practices, systems analysis and design, organizational design and administration, organization behavior, largescale complex system, organizational elements, management control systems elements, sustaining operations, projects, human relations, planning and control concepts, principles of management, engineering functions, product life cycle, research, design, development, production, use, Organization and Controls, Organization Fit and Function, Organization Form, Models, Structures, Organization Design and Analysis, Costs of Controls, Incentives, Financial and Budget Controls, MCS and Project Management, Planning, Leadership, Cases, Ethics, frameworks
